Class Creator

java.lang.Object
nl.pim16aap2.animatedarchitecture.core.tooluser.ToolUser
nl.pim16aap2.animatedarchitecture.core.tooluser.creator.Creator
Direct Known Subclasses:
CreatorBigDoor, CreatorClock, CreatorDrawbridge, CreatorFlag, CreatorGarageDoor, CreatorPortcullis, CreatorSlidingDoor, CreatorWindMill
public abstract class Creator extends ToolUser
Represents a specialization of the ToolUser that is used for creating new Structures.

  • Method Details

    • init

      protected void init()
      Description copied from class: ToolUser
      Basic initialization executed that should be called after the constructor.

      This method will initialize the Procedure using the steps generated by ToolUser.generateSteps() and register this ToolUser with the ToolUserManager.

      If this method is not called, the ToolUser will be considered uninitialized and any method that requires the procedure (e.g. handling input) will throw an exception.

      If this method is called more than once, an exception will be thrown.

      Overrides:
      init in class ToolUser

    • handleExceptional

      protected final void handleExceptional(Throwable ex, String context)
      Handles an exception that occurred during the creation process.

      This method will handle the situation as follows:

      • Log the exception at SEVERE level.
      • Send an error message to the player.
      • Abort the creation process.
      Parameters:
      ex - The exception that occurred.
      context - The context in which the exception occurred. E.g. "prepare_set_open_status".

    • completeCreationProcess

      protected boolean completeCreationProcess()
      Completes the creation process. It'll construct and insert the structure and complete the ToolUser process.
      Returns:
      True, so that it fits the functional interface being used for the steps.

      If the insertion fails for whatever reason, it'll just be ignored, because at that point, there's no sense in continuing the creation process anyway.

    • completeNamingStep

      protected boolean completeNamingStep(String str)
      Completes the naming step for this Creator. This means that it'll set the name, go to the next step, and give the user the creator tool.

      Note that there are some requirements that the name must meet. See StringUtil.isValidStructureName(String).

      Parameters:
      str - The desired name of the structure.
      Returns:
      True if the naming step was finished successfully.

    • confirmPrice

      protected boolean confirmPrice(boolean confirm)
      Attempts to buy the structure for the player and advances the procedure if successful.

      Note that if the player does not end up buying the structure, either because of insufficient funds or because they rejected the offer, the current step is NOT advanced!

      Parameters:
      confirm - Whether the player confirmed they want to buy this structure.
      Returns:
      Always returns true, because either they can and do buy the structure, or they cannot or refuse to buy the structure and the process is aborted.

    • isPowerBlockWithinRangeLimit

      protected final boolean isPowerBlockWithinRangeLimit(Vector3Di pos, Cuboid cuboid)
      Checks if the power block is within the range limit.

      If the power block is too far away, the player will be informed and the method will return false.

      If the distance limit is not set, the method will return true.

      If the power block is inside the structure, the player will be informed and the method will return false.

      Parameters:
      pos - The position of the power block.
      cuboid - The cuboid that defines the structure.
      Returns:
      True if the power block is within the range limit.
